field.optional: After the label of a field that may be left empty.
field.required: Read out by screen readers after the label of a required group of fields.
form.requiredNote: Above a form that marks its required fields with *.
error.label: Read out by screen readers before an error message (the label of the error icon).
errorSummary.title: Heading of the list of errors shown after a failed submit.
input.clear: Button that empties a text field.
status.loading: Read out while a control is checking or fetching something.
counter.maxLength: Read out with a field that has a character limit. {max}: the limit.
counter.charactersLeft: Under a field with a character limit. {count}: characters still allowed.
counter.charactersOver: Under a field with a character limit. {count}: characters over the limit.
validation.invalid: Error for a rule that gave no message of its own.
validation.unavailable: Error when a check (often on a server) couldn't run. The person can try again.
validation.required: Error for a field that must be filled in, chosen or ticked.
validation.minLength: Error for text that is too short. {min}: the minimum number of characters.
validation.maxLength: Error for text that is too long. {max}: the maximum number of characters.
validation.pattern: Error for text in the wrong format. Forms usually give their own message for this rule.
validation.email: Error for an email address that isn't valid. Keep the example address.
validation.phone: Error for a phone number that isn't valid.
validation.numeric: Error for a field that takes only the digits 0 to 9.
validation.decimal: Error for a field that takes a number, possibly with decimals.
validation.bool: Error for a yes/no question without a valid answer.
validation.insz: Error for a Belgian national register number (rijksregisternummer) that isn't valid.
validation.iban: Error for a bank account number (IBAN) that isn't valid. Keep the example IBAN.
validation.oneOf: Error for a choice that isn't one of the options (one answer).
validation.flags: Error for choices that aren't all among the options (several answers).
validation.compare: Error when a value doesn't match another field. Forms usually give their own message for this rule.
validation.date: Error for a date that doesn't exist or can't be read.
validation.dateMin: Error for a date that is too early. {min}: the earliest date allowed, written out in full.
validation.dateMax: Error for a date that is too late. {max}: the latest date allowed, written out in full.
validation.dateRange: Error for a date outside a range. {min} and {max}: the first and last date allowed.
validation.datetime: Error for a date and time that don't exist or can't be read.
validation.datetimeMin: Error for a date and time that are too early. {min}: the earliest allowed.
validation.datetimeMax: Error for a date and time that are too late. {max}: the latest allowed.
validation.datetimeRange: Error for a date and time outside a range. {min} and {max}: the first and last allowed.
